old: Notice that the tense never shifts: whether the journalist asks directly (*¿Qué pasó?*) or the exchange gets reported afterwards (*Preguntó qué pasó*), both verbs stay in the *pretérito* *indefinido*.
new: Here the question is already about a finished event, so the verb stays in the *pretérito* *indefinido* both in the direct question (*¿Qué pasó?*) and in the reported one (*Preguntó qué pasó*). Later you will see other tenses in reported questions.
why: "the tense never shifts" is false in general (reported questions backshift: preguntó qué pasaba / había pasado); say it only for these examples
